shared_context.topic: applying ointment to a pierced nipple

atoms.1: To apply ointment to a pierced nipple, follow these steps:
atoms.2: Wash your hands thoroughly before touching the area to prevent infection.
atoms.3: Clean the pierced area gently with saline solution or a mild, fragrance-free soap and water.
atoms.4: Avoid using alcohol or hydrogen peroxide as they can be too harsh.
atoms.5: Dry the area with a clean, soft towel or let it air dry completely.
atoms.6: Remove the jewelry if possible and if advised by your healthcare provider.
atoms.7: Removing the jewelry allows for better access to the area.
atoms.8: Removing the jewelry ensures the ointment can be applied directly to the skin.
atoms.9: Apply a small amount of ointment directly to the pierced area.
atoms.10: Use a clean cotton swab or your fingertip to spread the ointment evenly.
atoms.11: Reinsert the jewelry if it was removed, ensuring it is clean before doing so.
atoms.12: Repeat the application as directed by your healthcare provider, typically 2-3 times a day.
atoms.13: If you experience any signs of infection, contact your healthcare provider promptly.
atoms.14: Signs of infection include increased redness, swelling, pain, or discharge.
